task_text: Get all the paper scraps into the trash can, for example by sweeping them into the dustpan with the brush and emptying the dustpan into the can. Success: all 2 scraps are inside the trash can at the same time (each scrap's centre within the can's inner radius of its axis and between its floor and its rim). Pushing scraps off the table does not count. The goal must hold for 30 consecutive control steps (1.02 s); the episode then ends in success.
